name: Facebook
summary:
Facebook’s tab icon is the mark facebook.com sends for the social network. It is not the Messenger icon, which is fetched separately, and it is not a file to reuse on another product.

Checked 12 November 2026 against facebook.com. HTML came from https://www.facebook.com/ (HTTP 400). No icon link tags were readable in the HTML. Files below came from a manifest or from a path that returned an image.

The favicon.ico URL is https://facebook.com/favicon.ico. The saved file favicon.ico is 20366 bytes. Directory sizes: 16×16, 32×32, 60×60.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://facebook.com/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 webp.

No brand colour could be derived. The page had no theme-color, mask-icon colour, or manifest theme_color, and a dominant pixel colour was not readable from the saved PNGs.

Largest measured bitmap: webp-180x180-01.webp at 180×180 (webp, 908 bytes) from https://facebook.com/apple-touch-icon.png.
